name: Derivative steel and aluminum articles subject to transitional 15% Section 232 duty (Proclamation 11021 Annex III, as amended by Proclamation 11032)
notes: Annex III effective April 6, 2026 through December 31, 2027 per Proclamation 11021. After January 1, 2028, these codes move to Annex I-B (25% rate).

Amended by Proclamation 11032 (June 1, 2026, effective June 8, 2026): agricultural equipment (plows, mowers, combine harvesters, tractors for agricultural use, farm wagons) and residential/commercial HVAC equipment (window/wall AC units, heat pumps, evaporator coils) moved from Annex I-B (25%) to Annex III (15%) for all countries.
Rate structure per clause (5): for articles with column-1 duty < 15%, the SUM of column-1 rate + S232 rate = 15%. For articles with column-1 ≥ 15%, no S232 add-on.
This file models all Annex III items at rate=0.15 (15% total tariff) as an approximation. Most Chapter 84-85 items have column-1 rates of 0-3.5%, making the actual S232 add-on approximately 11.5-15%.
Exception: for countries with which the US does not maintain normal trade relations (column 2), the rate is 25% under clause (5)(c).
In the data pipeline, ANNEX_III_SAC is loaded AFTER SAC_DERIVATIVES so the 15% rate here overrides any 25% rate for overlapping codes (longest-prefix matching).

Original Proclamation 11021 Annex III steel derivatives: industrial dies (8207), nuclear reactor parts (8401), furnace parts (8417), filters (8421), sprayers (8424), conveyors/robots (8428), parts (8431.39/41), ingot molds (8454), rolling mill rolls (8455), machining centers (8457), parts for crushing/mixing (8474), injection molding machines (8477), misc machine parts (8479.90.95), molds (8480), shaft couplings (8483.60.80), bearing housing parts (8483.90.20), large transformers (8504.23).

Original Proclamation 11021 Annex III aluminum derivatives: sprayers (8424.89.90), misc machines (8479.89.9599, 8479.90.9596), large transformers (8504.34), transformer parts (8504.90.20/65/75/96xx), LCD device parts (9013.90.80).
